submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap is recommended based on superior time resolution performance. This configuration achieves 1.253 ns time resolution, which is the best among all viable options tested. It outperforms Mixture-G2 by approximately 38.7% across comparable gap sizes. Mixture-G3, while potentially offering different performance characteristics, is excluded due to its GWP100 of 1400, which significantly exceeds the laboratory's environmental policy limit of 150. The 2mm gap was identified as optimal through systematic simulation across the allowed 1-3mm range, with refined testing confirming this choice. Mixture-G1's GWP100 of 120 comfortably meets environmental requirements while delivering the best possible time resolution for the detector upgrade.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 at 2mm gap achieves 1.253 ns time resolution, the best performance among all viable configurations tested. This represents a 38.7% improvement over Mixture-G2.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is one of the three candidate mixtures (G1, G2, G3) specified in the project documents.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 has a GWP100 of 120, which is below the hard limit of 150 required by the laboratory's environmental policy.
The recommended gas gap of 2mm falls within the specified range of 1-3mm.
